observation_type: Observed CANDELS mosaics and simulated source increments

paired_observed_history.statistic: Maximum across paired epochs of the smaller same-epoch signed residual over its own band's control scatter.
paired_observed_history.scope: Identical spatial controls in both bands and every tested epoch. Their rank provides context, with shared reference data and no independent-trial probability.

scope: A source in one already drizzled epoch adds linearly to its leave-one-out difference. Orientation, detector position and centroid are varied using a grid of resampled WFC3 empirical PSFs. The flux is normalized over the sampled model and applied one site at a time. Recovery fractions are descriptive paired trials on observed residuals. The trials share data. They omit source shot noise, native exposure injection, color conversion, light-curve dilution and unobserved dates.
